Tuesday it plans to offer $350M of convertible senior notes due 2032 in a private placement to qualified institutional buyers.
Initial purchasers will have an option to buy up to an additional $52.5M of notes.
The company plans to use part of the proceeds to fund capped call transactions designed to reduce potential dilution, with the remainder for general corporate purposes.
The notes will mature on Oct. 15, 2032, unless earlier repurchased, redeemed, or converted.
The company intends to settle conversions in cash, shares, or a combination of both.
The interest rate, initial conversion rate, and other terms will be determined at pricing.
The capped call's initial cap is expected to be at least 150% above the company's latest reported sale price per Class A share.

title: Voyager Technologies announces proposed $350M convertible notes offering
